name: rAnS0m
summary: At the freshly dug dirt in Tanaris, Narain Soothfancy’s book is gone, and a ransom note waits in its place. You carry the letter back to Narain after searching for the book in Draconic for Dummies.

sections.title: A Note Made of Scraps
sections.body: Made from scraps of type, the ransom note tells Narain Soothfancy that its writers have his precious book. They call him a gnome and promise he will see it again only if he follows their orders exactly. Three pages give detailed instructions, ending with a demand that he bring the money and come alone. You carry the letter to Narain in Tanaris.

sections.title: Narain's Answer
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy asks what is wrong, then reads the letter. His face glows bright red. Outraged that someone has taken his book, he vows to show the culprits what it means to cross a psychic gnome.

faq.q: What is the ransom note demanding?
faq.answer: The writers claim to have Narain Soothfancy’s book and promise he will see it again only if he follows their orders. Three pages of instructions end with a demand for money and that he come alone. The note does not name its writers.

faq.q: Where does this step lead next?
faq.answer: After you bring the letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris, the chain continues with Decoy!

faq.q: What came before finding the ransom note?
faq.answer: Draconic for Dummies comes first. You search for Narain’s buried book and reach the freshly dug dirt.
